text: The `revisions-required` outcome label may not exist in a fresh repo; create it with `gh label create` (color FBCA04) before applying it.

child-page: never let an animation's end state exist only in a CSS keyframe (e.g. stroke-dashoffset line drawing); the global prefers-reduced-motion rule disables animations, so put the final state in the base/.on rule and use transitions or keyframes only for the motion.

Reviewer: for batches of near-identical child-page activity PRs, run the same mechanical checks on each (own files only, activities.js entry last, script tag before app.js, README count, node --check, CSS prefix) via gh api contents at the head sha, then read the issue's numeric criteria against the code.

Reviewer: when a review has any code-fixable optional suggestion, do not just accept — list it as a required change and apply `revisions-required` so the Reworker fixes it (owner rule, 2026-10-28); pure manual device checks and human judgement calls stay human tasks and do not block acceptance.
